what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: How a person gets their own agentic cell: a key in the browser, a vault they fill, the factory, and their own Claude.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: People ask for sites; the workflow is the product; key; their vault; five designs; own Claude; three gates.

sections.label: Why now
sections.line: The sites are cheap; collecting, designing and handing over is what costs, so build the workflow.
sections.para: Briefed by mistake in PrompTugal, written up there.

sections.label: Ask, with a key
sections.line: A start page, a key pair in the browser, and a signed request on an append lane, with no secrets.
sections.para: The worst anyone can do is send a request.

sections.label: Gate one: I approve
sections.line: The intake agent checks signatures and lists requests; I approve each with one tap.

sections.label: A welcome pack, sealed to your key
sections.line: A message sealed to their key with a template vault, their lane and a key scoped to one vault.

sections.label: Your vault, filled by you
sections.line: A guided app in their vault for photos, words, links, style and signed consent; then sealed to the factory.

sections.label: Gate two: I merge
sections.line: The factory writes a request; I merge; the apply workflow makes the repository, address and site.

sections.label: Five designs, back in their vault
sections.line: One factory session makes five designs, back into their vault, and they choose.

sections.label: Gate three: the hand-over
sections.line: A GitHub invitation I approve, and a CLAUDE.md for the owner; they continue in their own Claude.
sections.para: The invite made by a workflow, not a session.

sections.label: Security, and what it costs
sections.line: Sealed keys, signed requests, read keys only, signed consent, a security review, ten free cells.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A plan, a pilot scoped key, and a GitHub hand-over still to check.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The PrompTugal conductor's plan from my brief, and earlier articles.
